svg.title: Proposed architecture experiment order
svg.desc: Resolve product and trust contracts first. Run synthetic crypto, portable binding, and evidence attribution proofs before integrating real devices or production services. The diagram states dependencies, not completed work.

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 88) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1 · Contracts and failure examples
R01–R07: records, trust, recovery, ownership

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 88) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2A · Membership / conflict state machine
adversarial A-B-C fixtures · Gate 1

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 88) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2B · Portable binding smoke
Rust ↔ Swift / Kotlin · part of Gate 3

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 88) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2C · Codex-to-PR evidence fixture
model/usage attribution + corrections

div.style: color: rgb(73, 48, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3A · Rust crypto + durable local replica
directory relay · Gate 2

div.style: color: rgb(73, 48, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4A · Crash, replay, rotation, recovery
same bytes on retry; preserve pending work

div.style: color: rgb(48, 48, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5 · Native integration
local storage, key lifecycle, real devices

div.style: color: rgb(73, 48, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3B · User-facing findings
simple retrieval vs optional memory

div.style: color: rgb(73, 48, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4B · Disclosure / correction / deletion proof
local baseline; no agent feedback

div.style: color: rgb(48, 48, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6 · Relay + legacy import rehearsal
Gate 4; preserve original data

div.style: color: rgb(48, 48, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Later · Reviewed protocol + signed release
external review and operational acceptance
